patch_description: Restore the three-stage RZ structure (rz_pre → rz_mid → rz_post) which prior program 1 showed improves worst_group_margin (0.34). Replace the 6-interaction entangler with a 4-interaction focused subset that proved effective in prior program 2. Use aggressive parameter sharing: rz_mid is global (one param for all qubits), and rz_post alternates between even/odd to maintain structure while minimizing distinct params. The rz_pre remains global for initial phase alignment. This keeps distinct params at 10-12 while improving generalization through better structured depth and clearer worst-case separation.
